about: Questions written blind from merged vercel/next.js PRs (2026) and a few common tasks, without seeing AGENTS.md; answers labeled separately against the docs `agentindex import` made from it.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: [test] Reproduce two cache-sharing bugs
cases.question: How do I scaffold a new test with the repo's generator, and which test types can it create?
cases.note: pnpm new-test --args <appDir> <name> <type>; types e2e | production | development | unit (unit is flat test/unit).

cases.task: test: fix flakiness in segment-cache-stale-time
cases.question: How do I run one e2e test file locally, both in dev mode and in production (next start) mode?
cases.note: Step 2 runs pnpm test-dev-turbo / test-start-turbo <file>; testing lists dev and build+start scripts (file example in intro).

cases.task: Fix navigation from global-not-found to app routes
cases.question: Which test folder should a regression test for an App Router bug go in — test/e2e, test/development, test/production?
cases.note: Gives each folder's purpose: test/e2e end-to-end, test/development dev server, test/production production build. Brief, but tells them apart.

cases.task: Fix `export const foo = function bar(){}` in server reference transform
cases.question: For a bug fix, should I write a unit test of the internal function or an end-to-end test of the behavior?
cases.note: Prefer integration/e2e tests; avoid unit tests mapping to implementation except complicated algorithms; don't commit temporary ones.

cases.task: [test] Fix flaky file-system-cache-clock tests
cases.question: In e2e tests, what should I use instead of fixed timeouts or sleeps to wait for async results without flakiness?
cases.note: Use retry() from next-test-utils with expect() instead of setTimeout; check() is deprecated.

cases.task: test: deflake app-basepath external redirect test
cases.question: An e2e test fails without a useful message; how do I debug it with a visible browser or more verbose server logs?
cases.note: DEBUG=next:* debug logging; __NEXT_SHOW_IGNORE_LISTED=true shows full server stack traces. Nothing covers a visible browser.

cases.task: perf(build): lazily require page-data helpers in build/utils
cases.question: After editing source in packages/next, what do I rebuild before tests see my change, and is there a watch mode?
cases.note: Watch mode `pnpm --filter=next dev` in fast-local-development; packages/next edits need `pnpm --filter=next build` in both docs.

cases.task: Stop requiring build-all when bootstrapping a fresh clone or worktree
cases.question: What are the minimal steps to install dependencies and build the repo from a fresh clone?
cases.note: Bootstrapping paragraph: pnpm install, then build only what your work changes; build-all only for Rust.

cases.task: fix(turbopack): fix canary build after chunk_groups became a Vec
cases.question: How do I build the native Rust bindings locally so Next.js runs with my Turbopack changes?
cases.note: `pnpm build-all` for Rust/Turbopack changes: rebuilding rule, Stale Native Binary section, fast-local-development, build-commands list.

cases.task: Remove unnecessary `as any` casts
cases.question: How do I run TypeScript type checking for the whole repo, or just for packages/next?
cases.note: linting-and-types: pnpm types / pnpm typescript (root tsconfig); pnpm --filter=next types in the other two.

cases.task: Format all READMEs with Prettier
cases.question: How do I run ESLint and Prettier on just the files I changed before committing?
cases.note: Pre-validate block: exact prettier and eslint commands the pre-commit hook runs on changed files.

cases.task: ci: Fix ast-grep CI step
cases.question: The ast-grep step failed in CI on my PR; how do I run those rules locally and see what they flag?
cases.note: `pnpm lint` runs full lint including ast-grep; no ast-grep-specific command is documented.

cases.task: [ci] Fix test axis fixtures never running their off state in CI
cases.question: A test only fails in CI, not locally; how do I reproduce the CI environment and settings on my machine?
cases.note: Test Gotchas: match exact CI env vars (pr-status Job Environment Variables), CI command/mode, build_and_test.yml afterBuild flags.

cases.task: Investigate the failing CI checks on an open pull request
cases.question: How do I find the failing CI jobs on my pull request and read their logs from the command line?
cases.note: Dedicated doc: use the $pr-status-triage skill (scripts/pr-status.js) for CI failures; the commands live in that skill.

cases.task: Turbopack: test import.meta.glob code splitting with an execution test
cases.question: Where do Turbopack execution tests live, and how do I add and run a new one?
cases.note: Gives the location turbopack/crates/turbopack-tests/tests/execution/; adding or running a new one is not covered.

cases.task: Turbopack: add minServerChunkSize and maxMergeServerChunkSize options
cases.question: How do I add a new experimental option to next.config, including its config schema validation and TypeScript types?
cases.note: Intro 'Core runtime/bundling rules': new flags get type in config-shared.ts, schema in config-schema.ts, define-env.ts if bundled.

cases.task: Use a Node.js API in server code that is also bundled for the edge runtime
cases.question: What should I watch out for when packages/next code may run in both the Node.js and edge runtimes?
cases.note: Intro core rules: require() behind compile-time branches for DCE; force Node-only gating flags false in edge builds.

cases.task: chore: Remove package.json#workspaces
cases.question: How is the monorepo organized — where are workspace packages declared, and what lives in each top-level folder?
cases.note: Says pnpm monorepo and lists each top-level folder's contents; the workspace declaration file is not named.

cases.task: Search the codebase for where a runtime behavior is implemented
cases.question: Which directories contain generated or vendored code I should skip when searching, like compiled bundles or dist output?
cases.note: Intro bullet: generated dist/, node_modules/, .next/ are search-only, don't read; src/compiled not mentioned.

cases.task: docs: clarify use cache is unsupported in Proxy
cases.question: Where do the Next.js documentation pages live in the repo, and are there conventions for editing them?
cases.note: Monorepo tree lists docs/ as documentation; Documentation Code Blocks gives highlight={...} line-counting conventions.

cases.task: Open a pull request for a finished change
cases.question: What should a Next.js pull request title and description contain, and is there a template to follow?
cases.note: Descriptions: what changed and why, no AI footers, NEXT_JS_LLM marker at bottom; template .github/pull_request_template.md; no title rules.

cases.task: Report a bug discovered while working on an unrelated change
cases.question: If I find an unrelated bug, should I open an issue or a GitHub discussion, and what must it include?
cases.note: Membership rule, bug_report.yml issue template, what agents may draft, NEXT_JS_LLM marker; issue-vs-discussion choice not explicit.

cases.task: [lts-active] Don't load the app-page runtime in proxy.ts
cases.question: How do I backport a merged fix to an LTS release line, and how should the backport PR be titled?
cases.note: Only the $backport-pr skill entry: cherry-pick merged canary PRs to releases/lts/active or maintenance; no title convention.

cases.task: [cd] Gate release bot credentials behind GitHub environments
cases.question: What are the rules for handling secrets — may I print environment variables or tokens in logs, commits, or PRs?
cases.note: Intro rules: treat env values as sensitive; never print secrets in chat, commits or logs; redact output.
